text: dsh-rich-ui 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的富内容渲染插件，可把 rich-ui JSON 围栏显示为交互式界面。它向系统提示词加入格式说明，并注册文档校验工具；浏览器端解析围栏并渲染实体列表与详情、KPI、图表、表格、流程图、图片和音视频等内容。用户可在回复中使用本地计算器和表单控件，部分实体详情可放入原生侧栏。适合希望让模型回复以结构化、可操作组件呈现的 Web 用户；安装要求 DSH 0.2.x 和 Node.js 22.19 或更新版本。

dsh-rich-ui renders rich-ui JSON fences as interactive interfaces in the DSH web client. It adds format guidance and a validation tool, while the browser displays entities, metrics, charts, tables, media, forms, and local calculations. Requires DSH 0.2.x and Node.js 22.19+.

能不能把结构化内容渲染成带标签页、控件和流程图的界面？
如何让模型先检查富内容文档格式，再输出到聊天中？
Render structured model replies as interactive charts, tables, and cards in the chat.
Show a collection of entities with images and expandable details inside DSH.
dsh-rich-ui 的功能「交互式结构化回复」：rich-ui JSON 围栏经严格解析后渲染为布局、实体、指标、表格、图表和媒体组件；模型在聊天回复中提供文档，插件负责显示。
dsh-rich-ui 的功能「文档预校验」：宿主注册 rich_ui_validate 工具，模型可提交完整 JSON 文档并得到有效性、节点数或字段错误结果。
dsh-rich-ui 的功能「本地表单和计算」：回复中的输入框、选择器、滑块和开关可驱动声明式表达式求值，计算在组件中完成。
dsh-rich-ui 的功能「实体详情与侧栏」：实体列表和引用可打开详情面板；客户端检测宿主原生右侧栏能力，并提供面板渲染支持。

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：A model can describe a comparison, but a wall of Markdown makes the reader do the layout work. This plugin gives the model a small declarative language for the cases where structure carries the answer: side-by-side options, an object you want to inspect, a number the reader will change.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：The renderer is a real React tree behind a strict schema. There is no generated HTML, no `eval`, no shell access, and no page-level JavaScript from the model. Local controls recompute in the browser; the model is only called again when the reader explicitly asks.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：


In the lab the answer reflows beside the open panel. In Harness the same entity opens as a native right-column tab, so the conversation narrows instead of being covered — see the integration notes.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：


entity-list layout:"feature" gives a software shortlist a wide preview, the whole description and its sources. Below it, a captioned gallery shows one screenshot at a time.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：


Metrics, a two-series chart with units and hover, a filterable table with status pills and an ordered flow — one document.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：


Boxes inside boxes: the pool holds connections, the arrow shows what it talks to. The code block keeps language label, syntax colour and copy.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：


Sliders recompute the number in the browser; the model is not called again.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What this is, and why：


390 px: KPI cards in two columns, every chart label, and a table that still fits.

Scenarios: dashboard, films, listing, calculator, configurator, technical breakdown and the rejected-block diagnostic; add `&theme=dark` for the dark theme. Demo data is illustrative.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` and Node `22.19+`. No NixOS change, no patched Harness.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui
systemctl --user restart deepseek-harness   # or restart however your Harness runs
```

From a checkout — this is the loop the author uses:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui && cd dsh-rich-ui
npm ci && npm run build:plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
```

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Install：Unreleased commits: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui`.

The plugin registers itself as a bundle; the fence language is `rich-ui`.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Quick start：Ask for something that benefits from structure, in a new session:

```text
Compare three electric kettles by price, volume and features. Make it clickable.
```

The reply arrives as an interface: a summary strip, rows with photos, and a green highlight on the cheapest option. Opening a row shows facts, sources and related items without leaving the conversation.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Quick start：Things worth trying: *"build a budget calculator with three sliders"*, *"show this quarter as a chart and a table"*, *"make a configurator with tabs and conditional warnings"*.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What it can render：| Group | Nodes |
|---|---|
| Layout | `stack`, `row`, `grid`, `card`, `divider`, `meta` |
| Text | `text` with inline `code`, **bold**, links and `[[entityId]]` chips; `callout` with optional title; `code` with syntax colour, language label, line numbers and copy |
| Objects | `entity-ref`, `entity-list` in compact or `layout:"feature"` rows, with poster, square or landscape previews; entity details dock in the native right column or fall back to an in-page drawer, with a two-up photo gallery or one captioned screenshot at a time, plus cast |
| Data | `stat` (KPI card), `progress`, `status`, `table` (sortable, filterable, status and progress columns, scroll hint when it overflows), `chart` (bar / line / area / donut / scatter, 1–6 series, units, tooltips), `computed` |
| Flow | `diagram` with ordered steps, connector labels and branch depth; `layers` for boxes-inside-boxes architecture with member chips |
| Media | `image` with caption, `image-group` with optional per-frame captions and an inline `presentation:"gallery"`, `video` and `audio` with native controls, gallery lightbox, popover, tooltip |
| Controls | `input` (text / num

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · What it can render：Roughly 150 Lucide icons resolve by name, with semantic tones (`success`, `warning`, `danger`, `muted`) so colour means something. Light and dark themes follow the host palette and font.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · The contract in ten lines：The authoritative text is [prompt-rich-ui/prompt.md](prompt-rich-ui/prompt.md); exact fields, enums and budgets live in [references/schema.md](prompt-rich-ui/references/schema.md), and working documents in [references/examples.md](prompt-rich-ui/references/examples.md).

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Safety：| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Arbitrary code execution | Declarative JSON only; no HTML, CSS, JS, `eval` or property paths |
| Prompt-injected actions | Local actions cannot call tools; `send-message` needs an explicit click and is delivered as ordinary user text |
| Secrets in the UI | Password/secret state keys are rejected; no secret input components exist |
| Hostile URLs | `http(s)` only, credentials in URLs rejected |
| Resource exhaustion | Bounded depth, node count, string size and expression budget |
| Stored data | Persistence is opt-in, per session, and never stores text or date inputs |

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Parity with the reference：Measured, not claimed: **19 of 27** reference scenarios reproduced, **2 partial**, **6 missing** — with an itemised deviation list in [docs/PARITY.md](docs/PARITY.md). Missing today: Mermaid/ER graphs, math, maps, artifacts, persistent panels and mini-apps.

Known limitation: the fence label is not preserved by Harness, so an unlabelled block is claimed only when its payload looks like a spec document and passes the strict parser. A `json`-labelled block is never claimed.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Troubleshooting：**The block stayed as code.** The JSON did not pass the schema — usually an unknown field (`title` inside a node that has none, or `items` from another plugin's syntax). A claimed fence shows the exact error and the rejected source, and copies them on request. Nothing is executed, rewritten or sent automatically. The model should call `rich_ui_validate` before sending; if it did not, ask it to fix the document and validate it.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Troubleshooting：


A rejected block explains itself and copies the exact error and source. Nothing is sent automatically.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Troubleshooting：**Images show a placeholder.** The URL is wrong, blocked by the remote host, or not `http(s)`. Ozon/WB CDNs reject hotlinks; use a permitted source or your own media host.

**Old `dsh-ui` messages stopped rendering.** That is a different plugin's syntax. This one claims `rich-ui` only.

@kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui README · Interaction timings: docs/PERFORMANCE.md：```

Browser tests run in a pinned container so no system libraries are required:

```sh
docker run --rm --network host --ipc host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work \
  mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble npx playwright test
```

Scenarios in the lab: `?demo=dashboard`, `films`, `listing`, `apps`, `calculator`, `configurator`, `technical`, `primitives`, plus `&theme=dark`.
